# Sani Building Corp

> Sani Building Corp is a Brooklyn-based renovation and repair contractor serving all five NYC boroughs and Long Island since 2015. We handle residential and commercial work — bathroom renovation, tile installation and repair, grout restoration, kitchen cabinet installation, painting, flooring, carpentry, stairs, decks, water damage restoration and same-day handyman service — for homeowners, co-op and condo boards, property managers, restaurants, retail stores and offices. Fully insured. Rated 4.9 stars across 67 Google reviews.

We specialize in work that is quick to schedule and priced from a measured scope: regrouting and tile repair, no-demolition bathroom refreshes with waterproof wall panels, backsplashes, shower waterproofing, and single-room tile installation. Commercial work is scheduled overnight and at weekends so a restaurant or store never loses a day of trading.

## Contact
- Phone: (332) 277-0990
- Email: contact@sanibuildingcorp.com
- Address: 2954 Brighton 12th Street, Brooklyn, NY 11235
- Service area: Brooklyn, Manhattan, Queens, the Bronx, Staten Island, and Long Island (Nassau & Suffolk County)
- Free estimates. Fixed written prices, not hourly quotes.

## Tile, Grout and Shower
- [Tile Installation](https://www.sanibuildingcorp.com/bathroom-floor-tile-installation): Bathroom floor, wall and shower tile — porcelain, ceramic, marble, mosaic and large format. Waterproofed and set level.
- [Grout Repair, Regrouting & Tile Repair](https://www.sanibuildingcorp.com/tile-grouting-restoration): Regrouting showers, repairing cracked or missing grout, replacing broken tiles, grout cleaning, color sealing and epoxy grout.
- [Commercial Tile Installation](https://www.sanibuildingcorp.com/commercial-tile-installation): Restaurants, retail, medical offices, lobbies and building portfolios. Night and weekend installs.
- [Tile Installation Cost in NYC](https://www.sanibuildingcorp.com/tile-installation-cost-nyc): Published per-square-foot pricing — what bathroom, commercial and regrouting work actually costs in New York City and what changes the number.
- [Shower & Bathroom Wall Panels](https://www.sanibuildingcorp.com/bathroom-wall-panels): Waterproof acrylic and marble-look panels installed over existing tile. No demolition, no dumpster, most bathrooms finished in 1–2 days.
